detail: Investigation 2026-10-09 (read-only; nothing capped or changed). CAUSE: no CUSTOMERB-specific loop. Each specialist delegation is one eve child session that runs tool step after tool step, and every step resends the whole session history (instructions, every prior tool result) to GLM 5.3. eve has no step limit for subagents, compaction only fires at 90% of the configured 1,310,720-token window (~1.18M tokens, model.ts:141-146 via eve createCompactionConfig), and dataroom_read/dataroom_list return whole files (agent/lib/dataroom-tools.ts:118-166); bash/read_file cap at 50 KB per stream. So a long research run (20-40+ steps, context climbing to a few hundred thousand tokens) sums to 3-18M input tokens. The only real bound is eve's session input budget (root 40M, subagent gets parent's remaining / fan-out). RUNS (customerb-hfc, automation_runs; run_key = workflowUuid:session:turn): investor-presentations 2026-09-19 10:05 4.70M (cache 71%); 2026-09-25 14:14 wrun_41M3CEPMA50GWEMN096NKTZ6N5 turn_0 18.25M FAILED (abandoned: session ended without outcome) then turn_1 16:28 same session 6.07M (resumed turn resends turn_0 history; consistent with the session parking on its token budget and being continued - unverified). lodr-filings 2026-09-19 10:05 11.77M (row duration 77.5 h); 2026-10-06 02:31 wrun_41M47GSREW0GKNJ8NYNFR3XFW4 3.51M; 2026-10-07 02:30 wrun_41M4A35Y8B0GTQKDHM9VW8AT1G 5.63M, row still 'running' (refresh stopped at a dataroom_write approval nobody could answer). The Oct 6/7 lodr runs were not people: they are the starter App 'New LODR filings this week' refreshing on cron 30 2 * * 1-5 (library/hfc-research/apps.json). hfc-kpi-extraction 2026-09-22 19:38 4.88M FAILED (abandoned), 09-23 0.07M, 09-25 16:44 wrun_41M3CQ86P70GNMR6ENRCZVM820 2.60M FAILED (abandoned). Investor+lodr on 09-19 started 0.3 s apart (one parallel fan-out); no repeated calls of one specialist by the main agent seen. NOT CUSTOMERB-SPECIFIC: OnFinance AI's real research runs were the same size (investor-presentations 6.91M and 1.22M, lodr 6.34M and 5.46M, kpi 1.03M and 0.85M on 10-04/05); its ~0.5M/run average is diluted by ~30 smoke runs of 10-27k tokens on 10-06/07. CUSTOMERB's dataroom_file_versions is empty, so data-room size could not be blamed from the DB. CACHING: it partly works. Of 57.48M CUSTOMERB input tokens, 22.74M (39.6%) were recorded cache reads, 34.74M fresh; per run 0-71%; cache_write always 0 (Workers AI reports none). inputTokens includes cache reads (openai-compatible: prompt_tokens); lib/inference-pricing.ts:75-86 prices cached tokens at $0.26/M vs $1.40/M - no double count, no overstatement. Nothing requests caching: no x-session-affinity header (agent/lib/model.ts:93-99), eve's prompt-cache path is 'none' for this provider; Cloudflare says prefix caching is on by default for select models but hits need the request to land on the same instance, which x-session-affinity asks for (developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/prompt-caching/, updated 2026-04-21). Within a specialist turn the prefix is stable (no per-step timestamps); root dynamic instructions stamp observedAt per turn.
